description:
List dated additions and updates to the Vibe Shipped directory (apps built with AI, AI build tools, Agent Toolbox entries, agent harnesses), newest first.

Use when: you need to know what changed recently in AI coding tools, or to refresh a cached view since a date. Not for searching; use search_apps, list_tools or list_harnesses for that.

Behavior: Read-only. Each item has type, slug, name, change (added/updated), date, a url to cite, source and date_basis. since filters to changes on or after a date; type filters by entry type; limit caps results (default 50).

Example: {"since":"2026-10-15","type":"harness,agent-tool","limit":20}

since.description: Only changes on or after this date, format YYYY-MM-DD.

type.description: Entry type filter: app, tool, agent-tool or harness. Comma-separate several, e.g. "harness,agent-tool".

name: whats_new
title: What's new on Vibe Shipped
